statement: Suspension in the pointed W_S homotopy category is conservative, neither faithful nor full
depends_on: A.1; B.4; Hatcher 2002 Example 4.51 and proof of Corollary 4J.4; R9

notes: Cofiber rotation and James EHP make all 2-local spheres actual local targets. The nonzero Whitehead square has zero suspension. Fullness would lift a retraction of the suspended cofiber inclusion; conservativity would then force the Whitehead square to vanish. This proof also works in the formal localization without presupposing a small reflector.

notes: Coconnective fibers in the negative-shift nullification tower identify its colimit as stable C-local without compactness. Comparing Y_(i+1), not Y_i, controls mapping-space components. statement: All reversible localizers generated by connected polyGEMs, including nilpotent finite Postnikov pieces, have normal forms in one countable arithmetic list; hence countable CW generators and at most continuum many classes

manuscript_pages_settled: Part D.3 fixed-stable-part set-size: abelian/GEM generator subcase
notes: Torsion-free A reduces to Z[J^-1], J={p:pA=A}. Torsion and mixed groups reduce primewise to Fp, Cp-infinity, or Z_(p), plus BQ. Product-to-sum and rational-cokernel comparisons are proved at n=1 via homology, not disconnected-fibre acyclicity. No ordinary separatedness is assumed for Ext completion groups. Stanley rigid-abelian cardinal distinctions collapse after reversible closure. General D.3.2 remains open. PolyGEMs reduce by mutual ordinary acyclicity with their infinite symmetric products. A localizer in the BZ/p-to-Rloc(S/p) interval generated by connected infinite-loop spaces or polyGEMs is the lower endpoint.

General GEM-error fibres are bounded above by n-i using HFp-nullity; the two-step Y_(i+2) comparison and cone-attachment connectivity prove the missing higher-cover acyclicity. Original supported-only proof preserved in history note. Ordinary acyclicity uses exact Bousfield comparison. Class families reduce through small subfamilies. Adjacent Q-chain strictness remains open.
